descriptionEn: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.
summaryPt: Abre uma fissura de raízes que avança causando dano; as vinhas prendem e deixam lentos os inimigos por perto.
